Title: Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) on Lifecycle API Endpoints (/-/quit, /-/reload)
Analysis:
### Source
Untrusted browser-based HTTP requests initiated from third-party cross-origin sites.

### Sanitization/Validation
None. There is absolutely no verification of the `Origin` or `Referer` headers, nor is there any CSRF token check or custom header requirements (such as `X-Requested-With`) on the `/-/quit` and `/-/reload` endpoints.

### Sink
The server immediately executes termination (`h.quit`) or configuration reload (`h.reload`) upon receiving a POST or PUT request.

### Conceptual Exploit Payload
An attacker hosts a webpage with the following form and script:
```html
<form action="http://127.0.0.1:9090/-/quit" method="POST"></form>
<script>
  document.forms[0].submit();
</script>
```
When a victim who has access to a Prometheus server running on their local machine or internal network visits the attacker's page, the victim's browser automatically submits the form. The cross-origin POST request bypasses standard CORS restrictions because it is a simple request without custom headers, immediately terminating the Prometheus process (Denial of Service).

Title: Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) on TSDB Admin API Endpoints
Analysis:
### Source
Untrusted browser-based HTTP requests initiated from third-party cross-origin sites.

### Sanitization/Validation
The `api.deleteSeries`, `api.cleanTombstones`, and `api.snapshot` handlers check if `api.enableAdmin` is true. However, when the admin API is enabled (`--web.enable-admin-api`), there is no validation for CSRF tokens or custom headers, allowing cross-origin requests to perform destructive admin operations.

### Sink
The request initiates actions like deleting metric series data (`api.db.Delete`) or triggering database snapshots, leading to data loss or integrity issues.

### Conceptual Exploit Payload
An attacker hosts a malicious page with the following form:
```html
<form action="http://127.0.0.1:9090/api/v1/admin/tsdb/delete_series" method="POST">
  <input type="hidden" name="match[]" value="{__name__=~".*"}" />
</form>
<script>
  document.forms[0].submit();
</script>
```
When a user with active access to Prometheus (and who has `--web.enable-admin-api` enabled) visits the malicious site, the form is submitted automatically. This deletes all metric data in Prometheus.
Snippet:
// Admin APIs
	r.Post("/admin/tsdb/delete_series", wrapAgent(api.deleteSeries))
	r.Post("/admin/tsdb/clean_tombstones", wrapAgent(api.cleanTombstones))
	r.Post("/admin/tsdb/snapshot", wrapAgent(api.snapshot))

	r.Put("/admin/tsdb/delete_series", wrapAgent(api.deleteSeries))
	r.Put("/admin/tsdb/clean_tombstones", wrapAgent(api.cleanTombstones))
	r.Put("/admin/tsdb/snapshot", wrapAgent(api.snapshot))
